sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Re-run BFS with only grid-adjacent moves (dr+dc=1)
centers = [16, 22, 28, 34, 40, 46]

seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Build cell map again
cell_map = {}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] > 100:
        continue
    rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    r_idx = min(range(6), key=lambda i: abs(centers[i] - center_r))
    c_idx = min(range(6), key=lambda i: abs(centers[i] - center_c))
    key = (r_idx, c_idx)
    if key not in cell_map:
        cell_map[key] = []
    cell_map[key].append((n['id'], n['color'], n['pixels']))

# Build adjacency graph between grid cells (only grid-adjacent)
graph = {key: set() for key in cell_map}
for adj in seg['adjacency_list']:
    i, j = adj[0], adj[1]
    cell_i = cell_j = None
    for key, nodes in cell_map.items():
        for nid, color, pixels in nodes:
            if nid == i: cell_i = key
            if nid == j: cell_j = key
    if cell_i and cell_j and cell_i != cell_j:
        # Only add if grid-adjacent (dr+dc=1)
        dr = abs(cell_i[0] - cell_j[0])
        dc = abs(cell_i[1] - cell_j[1])
        if dr + dc == 1:
            graph[cell_i].add(cell_j)
            graph[cell_j].add(cell_i)

# Convert to sorted lists
for key in graph:
    graph[key] = sorted(graph[key])

# Find player and goal
player_pos = goal_pos = None
for key, nodes in cell_map.items():
    for nid, color, pixels in nodes:
        if color == 'b': player_pos = key
        if color == 'N': goal_pos = key

print(f"Player: {player_pos}, Goal: {goal_pos}")

# BFS
from collections import deque
queue = deque([(player_pos, [player_pos])])
visited = {player_pos}
path = None

while queue:
    (r, c), p = queue.popleft()
    if (r, c) == goal_pos:
        path = p
        break
    for neighbor in graph.get((r,c), []):
        if neighbor not in visited:
            visited.add(neighbor)
            queue.append((neighbor, p + [neighbor]))

if path:
    moves = []
    for i in range(1, len(path)):
        dr, dc = path[i][0]-path[i-1][0], path[i][1]-path[i-1][1]
        if dr == -1: moves.append('UP')
        elif dr == 1: moves.append('DOWN')
        elif dc == -1: moves.append('LEFT')
        elif dc == 1: moves.append('RIGHT')
    print(f"Path ({len(moves)} moves): {moves}")
    print(f"Cells: {path}")
    
    # Execute
    result = action(moves, intent='solve')
    print(f"Result: level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}, done={result.get('done')}")
else:
    print("No path found with grid-adjacent constraint")
    # Print graph for debugging
    print("\nGraph:")
    for key in sorted(graph.keys()):
        if graph[key]:
            print(f"  {key}: {graph[key]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
